allowedProductImports.reason: App bootstrap stays a thin base handoff into Android shell shortcut initialization.
Android exit hook stays as a thin base consumer of AndroidShellService.
The upstream logger remains a stable facade while the product layer owns bounded, pre-write-redacted diagnostic persistence.
The shared print facade applies the product redaction policy before logcat, file and in-app log consumers see a message.
System helpers stay a thin base delegate for Android task-back behavior.
AppController is the thin base orchestrator between global state and product compile/runtime/service contracts, including the existing log-export action.
Main stays a single bootstrap handoff into AppBootstrap.
AndroidManager stays a thin base consumer for exclude-from-recents shell sync.
AppStateManager may forward runtime mode and global-mode changes into AndroidShellService.
Config providers stay a thin base trigger for Android tile refresh after persisted profile changes.
State selectors stay thin in base and delegate product advisory and display policy into lib/product/subscription.
Subscription notifications stay a thin base consumer of product display policy and do not parse provider headers locally.
GlobalState may wire compile, security, runtime registry and engine manager callbacks without embedding product policy locally.
AboutView stays upstream-owned and delegates only the manual app-update check into ProductServices.
AccessView stays in base UI and uses ProductServices only for access-control editor state, package loading and profile-managed locks.
Settings items ask the product layer which switches the subscription provider actually manages, instead of hardcoding the lock in base UI.
ProfilesView keeps the live upstream page and reads product advisory data only for the support link menu hint.

allowedProductUi.reason: The fork-specific access-control trust warning is explicitly owned by the product UI layer while the upstream AccessView keeps only a thin mount.
The FlClashM Android updater owns its release prompt and in-app APK download progress dialog.
